label: Import companies(creation and updation)
description: Import companies from a CSV file with mapping options.

file.description: The CSV file to upload.The file should have the first row as the mapping attribute. Some default attribute names are (a) company_id [brevo mongoID to update companies] (b) associated_contact (c) associated_deal (f) any other attribute with internal name

processId.description: The ID of the import process
